subject: Tactical MAP: onramp auth, IP allowlist & VPC peering sprint plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Morales <s.morales@clarityhealth.co>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@clarityhealth.co>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Tactical MAP: onramp auth, IP allowlist & VPC peering sprint plan

Hi Sofia / Daniel —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our agreement, I put together a short tactical MAP slice focused on POC environment activation (auth, org setup, IP allowlist, and VPC peering). Please review and confirm windows. Attachment: clarity-map-v1.xlsx (MAP milestones & timeline).

Summary (high level):
- Week A (Aug 19–23): org + API key issuance; IP allowlist prep; security Q&A answers
- Week B (Aug 26–30): VPC peering window and smoke tests; performance baseline
- Close target: Sep 2 — successful end-to-end POC run and EVAL feedback loop

Immediate asks for Clarity Health: 
1) Confirm org admin(s) who will accept the Redwood invite (we will send two service accounts).
2) Provide network contact for peering (name + email) and preferred maintenance windows.
3) Share any required vendor paperwork or minimal security checklist we should fill out.

We propose a tentative peering window: Aug 21, 02:00–04:00 PDT (open to changes).

Attachments: clarity-map-v1.xlsx (MAP milestones)

Next step: if you confirm the windows, Naomi will kick off task assignments and calendar invites.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: clarity-map-v1.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

From: Sofia Morales <s.morales@clarityhealth.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@clarityhealth.co>, Clarity Health IT <it@clarityhealth.co>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 10:01:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Tactical MAP: onramp auth, IP allowlist & VPC peering sprint plan

Ben — thanks for this. We reviewed the milestones and have a couple of security/network clarifications before we lock a peering window.

Quick questions: 
- Can you send a simple network diagram for how Redwood will access our sandbox (NAT/IP ranges, peering subnets)?
- What is the expected lifetime and rotation policy for the API keys you issue during POC? Will keys be scoped per-tenant?
- We need a one-page checklist to share with our procurement/vetting team (they prefer PDF).

CCing our IT team (it@clarityhealth.co). I can do Aug 22 maintenance but would like to confirm the diagram and checklist first.

Thanks,
Sofia Morales
Director, Product | Clarity Health
Attachments: clarity-vendor-checklist.pdf (from our side)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Morales <s.morales@clarityhealth.co>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 12:34:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Tactical MAP: onramp auth, IP allowlist & VPC peering sprint plan

Hi Sofia — quick answers from security/infra: 
- Network diagram attached (poc-network-diagram.png) showing the expected peering subnets and NAT boundaries. For peering we recommend a /29 per side to keep BGP simple for the POC.
- API key behavior: we will issue tenant-scoped API keys with default TTL of 30 days for the POC and automatic rotation can be enabled via our console; keys are revocable per-tenant and we log key use with userid/trace IDs.
- Procurement checklist: we can fill out your PDF (thanks for sharing) and we'll also create a 1-page vendor summary for your procurement team.

Proposed peering window (flexible): Aug 21 02:00–04:00 PDT (Redwood prefers this for initial routing tests). If Aug 22 is easier for you, we can shift to Aug 22 03:00–05:00 PDT — please confirm.

Attachments: poc-network-diagram.png (PNG, 210KB)

Let me know the primary network contact and we’ll share a short connectivity test plan that their team can run during the window.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Infra & Security | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@clarityhealth.co>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Morales <s.morales@clarityhealth.co>
Cc: Clarity Health IT <it@clarityhealth.co>
Date: Thu, 15 Aug 2029 09:05:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Tactical MAP: onramp auth, IP allowlist & VPC peering sprint plan

Neha / Ben — thanks for the fast follow. Our network lead is Michael Chang (michael.chang@clarityhealth.co) and the team prefers Aug 22 03:00–05:00 PDT as the maintenance window.

A couple of asks from our side before we schedule: 
- Please provide a 10–15 minute smoke test script we can run during the window (simple curl to token endpoint + sample generation)
- Confirm sample API key TTL (30 days ok) and whether there is a test-only key with reduced scope we can use for validation.
- Share any expected ephemeral IPs from Redwood so we can add to our allowlist ahead of the window.

We’ve attached our initial vendor checklist (procurement) and looped in IT.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Program Manager | Clarity Health
Attachments: clarity-procurement-checklist.pdf (from Clarity)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Morales <s.morales@clarityhealth.co>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@clarityhealth.co>, Michael Chang <michael.chang@clarityhealth.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tactical MAP: onramp auth, IP allowlist & VPC peering sprint plan

Team — thanks for the confirmations. Locking in the mutual action plan slice and owners below so we have clarity before Aug 22 maintenance: 

MAP sprint (POC activation) — deliverables & owners:
- Send Redwood org invites & issue tenant-scoped API keys (Ben) — due Aug 19 EOD
- Fill procurement checklist and provide one-page vendor summary (Ben + Neha) — due Aug 20 noon
- Finish network prep and pre-flight diagram review (Michael + Neha) — due Aug 21 EOD
- Peering maintenance & smoke tests (Redwood + Clarity IT) — Aug 22 03:00–05:00 PDT
- Post-peering acceptance test & performance baseline (Jordan) — complete Aug 23 EOD

Attachments: signed-mpa-draft.pdf (placeholder — we will route for signature once checklist is complete).

Smoke test plan (short):
1) Network: confirm TCP handshake to Redwood peer IPs; ensure routing and ACLs accept /29 test subnets.
2) Auth: curl token endpoint with test key, verify 200 + X-Trace headers.
3) Generation: issue a single sample prompt to the staged model endpoint and validate latency < 500ms p50 for short prompts.

Action items for Clarity Health (next 72h):
- Michael: confirm peering VLAN/subnet and add Redwood /29 to allowlist (we will share exact IPs once the peering VLAN is provisioned).
- Sofia: confirm procurement contact to accept vendor summary and expected turnaround for the signature.

I added the HubSpot MAP card (link below) and will create calendar invites for the peering window and the pre-flight call. Please reply if any of the owners need to swap responsibilities.

HubSpot MAP: https://hubspot.company/contacts/CLAR-2345
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xMapPOC

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Technical Account Lead | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: signed-mpa-draft.pdf (pdf, 95KB)
